root_cause.text: In ath10k's CE pipe free functions, the code passed the aligned addresses (base_addr_owner_space, base_addr_ce_space) to dma_free_coherent() instead of the original unaligned addresses stored in base_addr_owner_space_unaligned and base_addr_ce_space_unaligned, which are the actual pointers returned by dma_alloc_coherent().
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes dma_free_coherent() calls in _ath10k_ce_free_pipe() and _ath10k_ce_free_pipe_64() from using the aligned fields to using the unaligned fields. The CVE description states: "dma_alloc_coherent() allocates a DMA mapped buffer and stores the addresses in XXX_unaligned fields. Those should be reused when freeing the buffer rather than the aligned addresses." The commit message and Fixes tag confirm the bug was introduced by commit 2a1e1ad3fd37.
